test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 04 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The performance of the team in the lost match was __dismal__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Luminous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"dismal"** means something that is depressing, gloomy, or causing a mood of sadness. (निराशाजनक)

 
 
• **Example: **The weather was dismal, with dark clouds and continuous rain.
 
 
 
• **"Luminous"** refers to something that is bright, shining, and full of light; it is the opposite of gloomy or dark. (प्रकाशमान)
 
 
• **Example: **The room was luminous, filled with natural sunlight streaming through the windows.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'dismal'** is **'luminous'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Luminous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Sadden** (दुखी करना): To cause someone to feel sorrow or unhappiness.

 
 
• **Example:** The news of his departure saddened everyone in the office.
 
 
 
• **Cheap** (सस्ता): Low in cost, or of low quality.
 
 
• **Example:** The store offers a variety of cheap goods, but they are not very durable.
 
 
 
• **Dainty** (नाज़ुक): Delicately small and pretty.
 
 
• **Example:** She wore a dainty lace dress to the party.
 
 

48:Tc67,

The correct answer is Option 2.</stro
